assets.prompt: Make one entirely original square inventory emblem for Grave Accord, a hand-painted 2D gothic fantasy action game. The gear belongs to Nela Venn, a water survey assistant turned Ranger. Match sturdy river-survey hardware with broad matte gouache shapes, dark quill-and-ink contours, warm old brass, dark ash and muted reed-green leather with off-white cord. Keep a deliberate, easily recognizable 32-pixel silhouette with generous clear alpha space on all sides. One complete centered object with real transparent background. No border, typography, lettering, numbers, markings, glow, cast shadow, scene or backdrop. A rugged squat rectangular portable surveyor’s reel, held together by a pair of soft-cornered olive green ash side plates. A large center of pale cord wound once around its short horizontal axle is easily readable. A broad warm brass carrying grip arches over the top and the attached end of the cord is secured in one broad clip. Emphasize the open top grip and horizontal body. No protruding free rope or stakes.
